categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the environmental catalyst sector, focusing on internal combustion engine exhaust purification catalysts for gasoline, diesel, natural gas vehicles, motorcycles, and ships. It also develops industrial VOCs catalysts, hydrogen fuel cell electrocatalysts, and energy storage and power batteries. The business includes R&D, production, and sales of these products, serving automotive and industrial pollution control markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-performance rare earth oxygen storage materials, high-temperature resistant alumina materials, high dispersion and stability of precious metals, and advanced coating technologies. Production involves precise slurry preparation, coating on ceramic or metal carriers, drying, calcination, and assembly into catalyst units and finished products. The company also develops SOFC stacks, solid-state batteries, and sodium-ion batteries with proprietary materials and processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs, mainly in the commercial vehicle, passenger car, and non-road machinery sectors. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with some export sales. It targets markets requiring compliance with stringent emission standards such as China VI and Euro VI, including natural gas heavy trucks, diesel vehicles, gasoline vehicles, motorcycles, and industrial VOCs treatment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, and other Chinese cities such as Changchun, Qingdao, and Huzhou. It serves domestic automotive and industrial markets, with limited overseas sales. The company is expanding its market presence domestically and internationally in energy storage and hydrogen fuel cell sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing core catalyst materials and assembling finished catalyst units for direct sale to engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs. It procures raw materials such as precious metals and carriers from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated catalyst products and systems downstream to vehicle manufacturers and industrial users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing catalyst technologies to meet increasingly stringent emission standards, expanding into new energy sectors such as hydrogen fuel cells and energy storage batteries, and enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. R&D focuses on rare earth and precious metal catalyst materials, solid-state and sodium-ion batteries, and fuel cell electrocatalysts. The company emphasizes innovation, patent development, and collaboration with academic and research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of catalyst products and systems to engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs under long-term procurement agreements. The company also earns revenue from industrial catalyst sales, energy storage and power battery products, and hydrogen fuel cell catalyst sales. Pricing mechanisms include metal-linked pricing for precious metals and cost-plus or market-competitive pricing for coatings and carriers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global environmental catalyst giants such as BASF, Johnson Matthey, Umicore, and Tanaka Precious Metals. It positions itself as a leading domestic innovator and supplier in China, progressively closing the technology gap with foreign competitors and expanding market share through product performance and cost advantages. It holds key industry leadership roles and participates in national standards and research programs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved significant growth with revenue of approximately RMB 1.54 billion, a 245% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 42.3 million, turning profitable after previous losses. Total assets reached RMB 2.65 billion, up 24% from the prior year. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~5.6% of revenue) and has expanded production capacity with new manufacturing facilities operational.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies in rare earth oxygen storage materials, precious metal dispersion, and advanced coating processes that enable high-performance, cost-effective catalysts meeting the strictest emission standards. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple fuel types and vehicle segments, supporting domestic emission regulation compliance and new energy vehicle development. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, coupled with strong customer relationships and national innovation platforms, differentiate it in the competitive environmental catalyst market.
